summary: Session 3 of 3 (final) ships the generate-migration CLI subcommand — the runnable product of the classify -> sanitize -> migrate pipeline and Phase 4 of the data-classification plan. GenerateMigrationCommand (COM-free; reads ir/ + reviewed classification.json + sanitize CSVs, never opens the .accdb) is wired into Program.cs dispatch (+ bare-file exclusion + usage/exit-code docs) with options --in/--out/--classification/--data/--json-status, emitting schema.sql (CREATE TABLE + PK + FK) + data.sql (FK-safe INSERT data-load with SET IDENTITY_INSERT framing) + migration-manifest.json (emitted files + table load order + every honestly-flagged degradation) under <out>/<database-slug>/. Exit codes: 0 clean / 1 usage / 2 unexpected / 3 completed-with-degradations. End-to-end emit against the committed HomeHealthCare golden IR plus a small committed sanitize CSV slice (tlkpStates non-identity FK-parent, tlkpPlanStatuses identity) produced committed golden schema.sql + data.sql + sample-data + READ-ME under samples/GoldenOutput/HomeHealthCare/migration/. New tests: MigrationGoldenScriptTests (Pipeline.Tests, hermetic + cross-platform: byte-golden schema/data with LF-normalization, dialect well-formedness, determinism, missing-data-not-dropped) and GenerateMigrationCommandTests (Integration, COM-free [Fact] black-box: files+manifest+--json-status envelope, usage errors, unknown-option rejection). Docs updated: interpretation-guide.md (new 5.5 generate-migration subsection + output-map note), install.md (COM-free list + subcommand list + exit codes + dedicated section), ROADMAP.md + data-classification-plan.md (Phase 4 shipped / arc complete / consumer-driven-only). Build 0 errors; AccessHarvester.Pipeline.Tests 787 hermetic green (incl. 5 new golden tests); GenerateMigrationCommandTests 4 green. Cross-provider verification gpt-5-4: R1 ISSUES_FOUND (Major: ParseOptions silently accepted unknown --options so a --data typo degraded silently; Minor: broad InvalidDataException catch misattributed IR/CSV failures) -> fixed (reject unknown switches; scope the classification catch) -> R2 ISSUES_FOUND (Minor: scoped read moved outside the command try, leaving non-parse read failures uncaught) -> fixed (read back inside main try with a tight nested catch) -> R3 VERIFIED, no regressions. This is the second and last remaining harvester set; the development arc is complete and the repo is now consumer-driven-only.
